behaviour: Documents the unread notifications home page card for both frontend systems.
rules: 1. A '## Home page card' section that says the card lists the signed-in user's latest unread notifications, newest first, each with a mark-as-read button and a link that opens and highlights the notification on the notifications page.

2. A '### New frontend system' subsection: the widget home-page-widget:notifications/unread-notifications is enabled by default and provided to the home page widgets when the notifications and home plugins are installed, uses 5 items and a 60-second polling interval, and can be disabled with a yaml example under app.extensions setting that id to false.

3. A '### Old frontend system' subsection: a tsx example importing UnreadNotificationsCard from '@backstage/plugin-notifications' and rendering <UnreadNotificationsCard limit={10} pollingIntervalMs={30000} /> on the home page, and a short list of the two props with their defaults (limit 5, pollingIntervalMs 60000).
4. One paragraph on live refresh: with @backstage/plugin-signals installed the card refreshes when notifications change; without signals it refetches every polling interval.

sites.rule: After the real-time notifications paragraph, insert a blank line and the section of rules 1-4.
